RANK: HSPT-RQ | position=4 | reason=it is the most expensive arm (0.20-0.25 s/epoch, 780-1050 s vs 571 s) and belongs to the exact mechanism family the frozen evidence measures worst (successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500 vs 0.0620-0.0636 for the mild arms) while its per-item transported codebooks make deep tokens item-specific precisely where E6/E7 show the prediction bottleneck; it names no behaviour-off/Euclidean switch pair and leaves the rho clamp unspecified, which the no-tuning policy forbids.
